notes: East-facing 40 × 50 ft (12.192 × 15.240 m · 2,000 sq ft) northeast corner plot bounded by a 12.0 m North road (opposite a colony garden, pergola, palms and a white/grey house with a dark blue-grey vertical facade, N-01) and a 9.0 m East road (opposite a tall pale metal mesh basketball-court enclosure and screening planting, E-01). Two light-coloured electrical feeder cabinets stand outside the Northwest corner in the North road paver verge (N-02), and a streetlight pole stands along the North frontage between the NE and NW corners (N-03). The ground-floor Residential Care Room (g-care, 3.50 × 5.45 m = 19.08 m²) is positioned in the North/Northeast zone strictly east of the plot's East–West midpoint (X_geo in [7.65, 13.40] m >= 7.620 m), enjoying direct northward sightlines across the 12 m road to the colony garden at reclined (1.15 m), seated (1.20 m) and standing (1.63 m) eye heights, plus an oblique eastward glimpse to the court enclosure. A shaded L-shaped North Veranda with slender teak-collared columns, warm Jodhpuri sandstone paving and a woven-cane seating corner connects the living hall, care room and Northwest Caregiver Suite (3.20 × 2.50 m single bedroom + 2.05 × 1.40 m attached toilet), while preserving a landscaped Northwest open garden pocket and West boundary separation. Upstairs houses two family bedrooms with bathrooms, a compact office/studio, an upper store, east and north sandstone terraces, and continuous stair access to the roof terrace.
